name: Aravindh Varadharaj
title: Full-Stack Developer · Three Python + Three Go Platforms · Next.js & React
summary: Builder at Amazon since 2021 in digital marketing, where I developed and automated internal workflows. I now build six distinct platforms: Python systems for enterprise open learning, historical famine analysis and animal welfare; and Go systems for general disaster impact, nuclear civil safety and wildlife-aware wireless efficiency. Each has a live React interface, tested API, explicit uncertainty and a documented production path. I am eager to build useful technology with communities that care about everyday impact.

bullets: Developed and automated internal tools and workflows for my team, replacing repetitive manual tasks with reliable, reusable solutions.
Worked with stakeholders to identify process gaps, then designed, built, and supported automation that the team adopted in daily work.
Grew from a marketing role into hands-on development, building a portfolio of full-stack Python projects outside my core responsibilities.

projects.name: EcoSignal
projects.subtitle: Reduce unnecessary wireless transmission while preserving essential connectivity.
projects.tagline: A Go constrained optimizer inventories routers, gateways, phones and laptops; preserves network coverage; and reduces configurable transmit power and idle airtime while reporting a relative habitat activity proxy.
projects.problem: Wireless devices share spectrum near homes and wildlife habitats, but software cannot honestly claim one universal safe RF level for every species.
projects.solution: A Go constrained optimizer inventories routers, gateways, phones and laptops; preserves network coverage; and reduces configurable transmit power and idle airtime while reporting a relative habitat activity proxy.
highlights: Enumerates configurable access-point/gateway power plans under a minimum coverage constraint
Compares current and optimized RF activity maps, device duty cycles and energy while preserving an essential emergency gateway
engineering_decisions: Never labels a configuration biologically safe without calibrated measurements and expert review
Does not jam, alter unauthorized frequencies or pretend to control phone/laptop radios
projects.production_path: Integrate calibrated RF meters, supported router-management APIs, measurement provenance, legal spectrum profiles and qualified RF/ecology review.
